headline: He just had to survive five minutes in the ring, and Boat came out on top Lil Yachty made
body: He just had to survive five minutes in the ring, and Boat came out on top Lil Yachty made his WWE debut in his hometown of Atlanta last night. He survived five minutes against United States Champion Baron Corbin, with Tyler, The Creator @feliciathegoat, Quavo and the Concrete Boys all in attendance to support him. Quavo also premiered his upcoming track “BACKWARDS” with TI, dropping this Friday. (: GETTY | : ).
